title_zh: 苹果支持社区将于 11 月 20 日永久关闭
content_zh:
苹果在支持社区首页发布公告，宣布论坛将于 11 月 20 日永久关闭。网站现已转为只读，用户仍可浏览和搜索已有讨论，新问题和回复已停止接收。

该论坛长期供苹果用户交流 iPhone、Mac 等产品的使用问题。苹果的用户互助论坛可追溯到 1998 年上线的 Apple Tech Exchange，期间几度改名，2022 年启用 Apple Support Community 这一名称。苹果在公告中将后续的产品指导和技术帮助指向官方 Apple 支持网站。
title_en: End of an Era: Apple Support Community to Close Permanently on November 20
content_en:
Apple has announced that its official Support Community forum will permanently shut down on November 20. The platform has already transitioned to a read-only mode, allowing users to search and browse existing discussions while disabling new posts and replies.

Tracing its roots back to the "Apple Tech Exchange" launched in 1998, the forum has served as a central peer-to-peer troubleshooting hub for decades. Moving forward, Apple is directing users to seek technical assistance and product guides via the official Apple Support website.

title_zh: 再曝婚外情，曝英伟达董事会考虑罢免黄仁勋
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达董事会正准备讨论 CEO 黄仁勋的去留问题，最早可能于当地时间 11 月 11 日召开会议。

此前，黄仁勋被曝涉及两段婚外关系。消息传出后，英伟达股价在盘后交易中一度下跌约 8%。

《纽约时报》另报道称，黄仁勋还曾与英伟达医疗业务副总裁 Kimberly Powell 存在婚外关系，后者在工作中直接向黄仁勋汇报。

本月 8 日，黄仁勋曾在致员工的内部信中承认婚外关系，并向家人道歉。英伟达董事会随后宣布启动独立调查，并公开表达了对黄仁勋领导能力的信心。
title_en: Nvidia Board Weighs Ousting CEO Jensen Huang Amid Affair Allegations
content_en:
The Nvidia Board of Directors is reportedly preparing to discuss the future of CEO Jensen Huang, with a meeting scheduled as early as November 11, according to *The Wall Street Journal*. The development caused Nvidia's stock to drop roughly 8% in after-hours trading.

Reports indicate Huang was involved in extramarital affairs, including one with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's Vice President of Healthcare, who directly reported to him.

Huang acknowledged the affairs and apologized to his family in an internal memo to employees on November 8. Although the board has launched an independent investigation, it previously expressed public confidence in his leadership.

title_zh: 余承东官宣华为子品牌 OSTA 星芒，11 月 20 日首秀
content_zh:
华为终端 BG 董事长余承东 11 月 11 日宣布，华为全新子品牌 OSTA 星芒将在 11 月 20 日 14:30 举行的鸿蒙智行发布会上首次亮相。余承东这条微博的发帖设备标识显示为「OSTA O1 Pro」。

同场发布会上，鸿蒙智行旗下的享界 V8 将正式上市，尚界 Z7T 星野套装也将亮相。
title_en: Huawei to Debut New Sub-Brand 'OSTA' on November 20
content_en:
Richard Yu, Chairman of Huawei Consumer BG, announced that Huawei's new sub-brand, "OSTA," will officially debut on November 20 during the Harmony Intelligent Mobility launch event. Yu posted the announcement on social media using a device identified as the "OSTA O1 Pro."

The event will also feature major automotive updates, including the official market launch of the Xiangjie V8 and the debut of the Shangjie Z7T Xingye package under the Harmony Intelligent Mobility alliance.

title_zh: 曝字节计划推出「中国版 Muse」
content_zh:
彭博社 11 月 11 日援引知情人士称，字节跳动计划在未来几周推出一款类似 Meta Muse 的 AI 助手。字节跳动联合创始人张一鸣近日在 AI 团队的全员会上向研究人员、工程师等员工介绍了这一计划。

据报道，张一鸣在会上把训练数据列为优先事项，并判断字节最快也要到 2029 年或 2030 年，才能在最前沿的模型能力上与 OpenAI、Anthropic 等公司竞争。彭博社将 Muse 描述为一款以语音交互为主、配有动画化身的助手，Meta 正把它接入多款智能眼镜。

🔗 相关阅读：曝字节要做「中国版 Muse」，给豆包造个「超级大脑」
title_en: ByteDance Reportedly Planning AI Assistant Similar to Meta's Muse
content_en:
ByteDance plans to launch an AI assistant similar to Meta's Muse in the coming weeks, according to a Bloomberg report citing sources familiar with the matter. Co-founder Zhang Yiming recently introduced the project during an all-hands meeting with the company's AI research and engineering teams.

During the meeting, Zhang highlighted training data as a top priority. He estimated that ByteDance may not be able to compete with frontier AI leaders like OpenAI and Anthropic until 2029 or 2030 at the earliest.

Meta's Muse is described as a voice-first assistant featuring animated avatars, which Meta is currently integrating into its line of smart glasses.

title_zh: 小米澎程首个完整交付月，两款车零售合计超 2.7 万辆
content_zh:
10 月是小米澎程系列开启交付后的首个完整月份。雷军公布的 10 月新能源车零售榜显示，澎程 N70 零售 14,545 辆，N90 零售 12,587 辆，两款车型合计 27,132 辆。

据小米澎程公布的细分榜单，五座增程 SUV 澎程 N70 位列 10 月增程车和中大型 SUV 零售榜首。七座增程 SUV 澎程 N90 在涵盖不同能源类型的大型 SUV 零售榜中排名第一。
title_en: Xiaomi's Pengcheng Series Surpasses 27,000 Deliveries in First Full Month
content_en:
October marked the first full month of deliveries for Xiaomi's Pengcheng series, achieving total retail sales of 27,132 vehicles, according to figures released by CEO Lei Jun. Sales were driven by the Pengcheng N70 with 14,545 units and the N90 with 12,587 units.

Both models topped sales charts in their respective categories. The five-seat range-extended SUV, Pengcheng N70, ranked first in October retail sales for both range-extended electric vehicles (EREVs) and mid-to-large SUVs.

Meanwhile, the seven-seat range-extended SUV, Pengcheng N90, captured the top spot in overall large SUV retail sales across all powertrain types.

title_zh: 张雪机车第 10 万台整车在重庆下线
content_zh:
11 月 11 日，张雪机车的第 10 万台整车在重庆生产基地下线。据《每日经济新闻》报道，公司提前达到今年 9 月重庆摩博会上提出的年末产量目标。

在 9 月的摩博会上，张雪机车同时展示了多条产品线，包括巡航车型 600V 和品牌首款中排量硬派 ADV 车型 820X，并发布了 820RR 的赛道版和全碳纤维版。
title_en: Zhangxue Motorcycle Rolls Off 100,000th Vehicle Ahead of Schedule
content_en:
Zhangxue Motorcycle reached a major milestone on November 11 as its 100,000th complete vehicle rolled off the assembly line at its Chongqing manufacturing base. According to *National Business Daily*, the company achieved its year-end output target ahead of schedule.

The target was originally announced during the Chongqing International Motorcycle Expo in September, where Zhangxue showcased several product lines. Featured models included the 600V cruiser, the brand's first mid-displacement adventure bike (820X), as well as track and full-carbon fiber editions of the 820RR.

title_zh: 腾讯入局搜索，网页端元宝搜索上线
content_zh:
11 月 11 日，腾讯正式推出元宝搜索。用户可直接访问独立网站 so.qq.com，也可以在新版 QQ 浏览器的引擎设置中切换到元宝搜索。

据界面新闻报道，元宝搜索基于腾讯元宝的大模型能力组织答案。检索范围包括公开网页、微信公众号文章、视频号内容及学术文献，结果优先展示权威机构和官方信源。腾讯在结果页将广告和答案分开展示。
title_en: Tencent Enters Search Engine Market with AI-Powered 'Yuanbao Search'
content_en:
Tencent has officially launched **Yuanbao Search**, marking its latest foray into the search engine market. Users can access the platform directly at `so.qq.com` or select it as their default search engine in the newest release of QQ Browser.

Powered by Tencent's proprietary Yuanbao large language model, the search tool aggregates results across public web pages, WeChat Official Account articles, Channels video content, and academic literature. To enhance answer quality and transparency, Yuanbao Search prioritizes official and authoritative sources while distinctly separating advertisements from core search results.

title_zh: 曝 Anthropic 承销商考虑上调 IPO 发行价
content_zh:
据《金融时报》报道，Anthropic 的承销商正考虑在现有招股区间之上定价。报道援引知情人士称，路演期间的投资者需求是讨论提价的原因，按消息人士所述方案，公司 IPO 估值可能达到 1.5 万亿美元或更高。

Anthropic 11 月 10 日递交的招股文件列出的预计发行价仍是每股 70 美元至 78 美元。文件列明，此次拟公开发售 8.25 亿股 A 类普通股，部分由现有股东出售，Anthropic 已申请以「ANT」为代码在纳斯达克上市。
title_en: Anthropic Underwriters Weigh Raising IPO Price Range Amid Surging Demand
content_en:
Underwriters for AI startup Anthropic are considering pricing its initial public offering above the targeted range, according to a report by the *Financial Times*. Strong investor demand during the company's roadshow has driven discussions of a price hike, which could push Anthropic's IPO valuation to $1.5 trillion or higher.

According to regulatory filings submitted on November 10, Anthropic had initially set an estimated price range of $70 to $78 per share. The filing covers an offering of 825 million Class A common shares, including shares sold by existing stockholders. Anthropic has applied to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol **ANT**.

title_zh: 我国算力总规模达 310 万 PFLOPS，全国数标委成立具身智能数据标准起草组
content_zh:
据央视新闻报道，国家数据局披露，我国算力总规模已达到 310 万 PFLOPS，位居世界第二。该数据在全国数据标准化技术委员会第二次「标准周」活动期间披露。活动于 11 月 9 日至 13 日在厦门举行。

11 月 10 日的开幕式上，全国数标委成立了具身智能数据标准起草工作组，以及气象、卫生健康、电力、商务四个行业应用标准起草工作组。标准周还安排了高质量数据集安全技术要求、数据流通安全审计规范等技术议题的研讨。
title_en: China's Computing Power Reaches 3.1M PFLOPS as New Embodied AI Standards Group Formed
content_en:
China's total computing capacity has reached 3.1 million PFLOPS, maintaining its position as the second-largest in the world, according to figures released by the National Data Bureau during the National Data Standardization Technical Committee's event in Xiamen.

At the opening ceremony, the committee announced the establishment of a specialized working group to draft data standards for **embodied AI**, alongside four industry application drafting groups covering meteorology, healthcare, electric power, and commerce. The event also focused on technical requirements for dataset security and standards for data circulation security audits.

title_zh: 字节 AI 芯片负责人被曝提出离职，团队正研发下一代芯片
content_zh:
据《晚点 LatePost》报道，字节跳动 AI 芯片与 DPU 团队负责人施云峰已提交离职申请，目前正在交接。他于 2018 年加入字节跳动，向字节跳动副总裁、火山引擎业务负责人杨震原汇报。

报道称，字节自研 AI 芯片走的是类似谷歌 TPU 的专用芯片路线。今年已有相关芯片完成流片，实际性能未达到团队预期，团队正推进下一代芯片研发。面向豆包的 Ada 和面向视频生成模型 Seedance 的 SeedChip 都在做算子适配，字节自研芯片目前尚未在内部业务中大规模部署。
title_en: ByteDance AI Chip Lead Resigns as In-House Silicon Falls Short of Expectations
content_en:
Shi Yunfeng, head of ByteDance’s AI chip and DPU team, has submitted his resignation and is currently handing over his duties, according to a report by *LatePost*. Shi joined ByteDance in 2018 and reported directly to Yang Zhenyuan, Vice President of ByteDance and head of Volcano Engine.

ByteDance has been developing custom AI chips following a specialized ASIC route similar to Google’s TPU. However, chips taped out earlier this year failed to meet internal performance expectations, prompting the team to pivot toward developing the next generation of silicon.

Currently, the team is adapting operators for its custom chips, including "Ada" for the Doubao LLM and "SeedChip" for the video generation model Seedance. ByteDance has not yet deployed its proprietary chips on a large scale across its internal operations.

title_zh: 北京印发具身智能机器人三年行动方案，提出上市一对一服务
content_zh:
北京市经济和信息化局 11 月 11 日印发《北京市具身智能机器人产业高质量发展行动方案（2026—2028 年）》。方案提出建立面向具身智能机器人企业的上市一对一服务机制，并在整机、零部件、模型和数据采集等领域培育创新型企业。

北京提出，到 2028 年力争培育不少于 5 家国际一流、10 家国内领先的人形机器人整机企业。方案还提出新增建设总规模超过 50,000 PFLOPS 的具身智能专用算力集群，并以京津冀区域整机产能占全国 25%、关键零部件配套率超过 60% 为目标。
title_en: Beijing Unveils 3-Year Embodied AI Robotics Plan featuring IPO Support and Infrastructure Expansion
content_en:
The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology published its *Embodied Intelligent Robotics Industry High-Quality Development Action Plan (2026–2028)* on November 11. The plan introduces tailored, one-on-one IPO advisory services for robotics companies while accelerating innovation across complete systems, core components, AI models, and data collection.

By 2028, Beijing aims to cultivate at least five world-class and ten domestically leading humanoid robot manufacturers.

To power this initiative, the city plans to build dedicated computing clusters exceeding 50,000 PFLOPS for embodied AI. Additionally, the broader Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region aims to account for 25% of China's complete humanoid robot production capacity and supply over 60% of critical components locally.

title_zh: 「小米换机」上架鸿蒙应用市场，可把旧机资料迁往小米
content_zh:
「小米换机」已出现在华为鸿蒙应用市场，开发者为北京小米移动软件有限公司南京分公司。鸿蒙版商店截图显示，应用在旧设备一侧提供迁移入口，用户可在传输前选择图片、联系人等资料。

小米官方应用商店此前提供的小米换机支持 Android 和 iOS 旧设备向小米新机迁移。此次上架让鸿蒙旧机也有了从应用市场直接安装的入口。实际能迁移哪些数据，取决于旧设备及所用版本。
title_en: Xiaomi’s Data Migration App Arrives on Huawei’s HarmonyOS Store to Ease Switchers
content_en:
Xiaomi’s data migration tool, "Mi Switch," has officially launched on Huawei’s HarmonyOS AppGallery. Developed by Xiaomi Mobile Software's Nanjing branch, the app allows users to easily transfer data—such as photos and contacts—from older HarmonyOS devices to new Xiaomi smartphones.

While Xiaomi’s transfer tool previously supported data migration from standard Android and iOS devices, this listing provides HarmonyOS users with a direct installation pathway from their native app store.

The specific types of data eligible for transfer will depend on the source device and its operating system version.

title_zh: Stripe 完成对 AI 模型网关 OpenRouter 的收购
content_zh:
支付公司 Stripe 确认，AI 模型网关 OpenRouter 已正式并入 Stripe。两家公司于 8 月宣布收购协议。开发者可以通过 OpenRouter 的统一接口调用不同供应商的模型，并按价格、速度等条件选择推理服务。OpenRouter 此前表示，现有接口接入方式和产品路线图会继续沿用。

OpenRouter 公布的数据显示，平台 10 月处理了 790 万亿 Token，比 9 月增长 37%。按工具调用频率、对话轮数等信号分类，智能体类 API 密钥占当月 Token 用量的 76%，一年前这一比例为 8%。
title_en: Stripe Finalizes Acquisition of AI Gateway OpenRouter
content_en:
Payments giant Stripe has officially completed its acquisition of OpenRouter, an AI model gateway, following an agreement announced in August. OpenRouter provides developers with a unified API to access AI models from various providers, enabling seamless selection based on price, speed, and other performance metrics. The company assured users that existing API integrations and product roadmaps will remain intact.

According to recently released platform data, OpenRouter processed 790 trillion tokens in October, representing a 37% month-over-month growth. Driven by automated tool calls and multi-turn conversations, AI agent-related API keys accounted for 76% of total token usage that month—a massive surge from just 8% a year earlier.

title_zh: 马斯克称 Cybertruck 将生产至 2027 年夏末，以消化积压订单
content_zh:
据 CBS 新闻报道，特斯拉 CEO 马斯克于当地时间 11 月 11 日表示，Cybertruck 的生产将延续至 2027 年夏末，让工厂有更多时间完成积压订单。

马斯克此前给出的时间是 2027 年年中。他当时表示，订单量超过了剩余产量，部分订金可能需要退回。

🔗 相关阅读：曾号称订单超百万，累计仅卖 6.3 万辆，量产不到四年的特斯拉 Cybertruck 官宣停产
title_en: Musk Extends Cybertruck Production Timeline to Late Summer 2027
content_en:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced on November 11 that Cybertruck production will continue through late summer 2027, granting the factory extra time to fulfill remaining backlogged orders, according to CBS News.

This extends Musk's previous target of mid-2027. He had earlier noted that order demand surpassed the planned remaining output capacity, indicating that some customer deposits might eventually need to be refunded.

title_zh: 《毁灭全人类！》重制版开发商独立，参与创立新游戏集团
content_zh:
《毁灭全人类！》重制版开发商 Black Forest Games 通过管理层收购脱离 THQ Nordic，成为独立工作室。新成立的独立游戏集团 Third Signal 宣布，Black Forest Games 是创始成员，其管理层也将持有集团股份。

这家德国工作室自 2017 年起隶属于 THQ Nordic。今后它将继续以自有品牌开发和发行游戏，并和 THQ Nordic 保持项目合作。
title_en: 'Destroy All Humans!' Remake Studio Goes Independent, Joins New Gaming Collective
content_en:
Black Forest Games, the developer behind the *Destroy All Humans!* remake, has separated from THQ Nordic through a management buyout to regain its status as an independent studio. Newly established gaming collective Third Signal revealed that Black Forest Games is a founding member, with its leadership team holding equity in the group.

The German studio had been an operating subsidiary of THQ Nordic since 2017. Moving forward, Black Forest Games will develop and publish titles under its own brand while maintaining project-based collaborations with THQ Nordic.

title_zh: 日产上半财年营业利润转正，归母净亏损收窄
content_zh:
日产汽车公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的上半财年业绩。按合并财报口径，营业利润由亏转盈，录得 800 亿日元。归属于母公司股东的净亏损由 2,219 亿日元收窄至 397 亿日元。

日产在财报演示材料中将制造成本改善、汇率和部分一次性因素列为上半年营业利润的正向因素。公司也在利润变动表中单列了原材料和关税的负向影响。
title_en: Nissan Returns to Operating Profit in First Half as Net Loss Narrows Sharply
content_en:
Nissan Motor Co. has reported its financial results for the first half of the fiscal year ending September 30. The automaker achieved a financial turnaround, posting a consolidated operating profit of 80 billion yen. Meanwhile, the net loss attributable to owners of the parent narrowed significantly to 39.7 billion yen, down from 221.9 billion yen in the same period last year.

In its earnings presentation, Nissan attributed the positive shift in operating profit to manufacturing cost improvements, favorable exchange rates, and certain one-off factors. However, the company noted that these gains were partially offset by rising raw material costs and tariff pressures.

title_zh: 💡 Omdia 研究总监：预计 6G 于 2029 年商用，普及速度将慢于 5G
content_zh:
Omdia 电信数据战略研究总监威廉·汤普森-黑尔11 月 11 日撰文指出，首批 6G 服务将在 2029 年于中国、美国等市场推出，初期覆盖将集中在人口密集的大城市。他判断，运营商初期可能让 5G 与 6G 共用现有频谱，先在局部区域上线。

他预计，到 2031 年，全球 6G 订阅量约为 4.24 亿，占移动订阅的约 2.8%。他把中国列为早期最大市场，预计同年在中国出货的智能手机约有 45% 支持 6G。

汤普森-黑尔认为，智能手机已经相当普及，换机周期也在拉长，加上 6G 终端初期成本较高，现有 4G 和 5G 又能满足多数日常用途，单凭连接升级很难推动用户提前换机。

汤普森-黑尔建议运营商把投资重点放在物联网、物理 AI 和通感一体等具体场景。他举出的例子包括超视距无人机作业、智能交通管理和实时环境监测。
title_en: Commercial 6G Expected in 2029 with Slower Adoption Than 5G, Says Omdia
content_en:
Commercial 6G services are projected to launch in 2029 in major markets such as China and the U.S., according to William Thompson-Hare, Research Director of Telecom Data Strategy at Omdia. Initial rollouts are expected to focus on densely populated urban areas, with operators initially sharing existing spectrum between 5G and 6G networks.

Omdia forecasts that global 6G subscriptions will reach approximately 424 million by 2031, representing roughly 2.8% of all mobile subscriptions. China is expected to lead early adoption, with 6G-enabled models accounting for about 45% of smartphone shipments in the country by 2031.

However, overall adoption is expected to be slower than 5G due to high initial device costs, lengthening smartphone replacement cycles, and existing 4G and 5G networks already satisfying consumer demands. Thompson-Hare recommends that telecom operators prioritize investments in targeted enterprise scenarios—such as IoT, physical AI, and Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC)—including autonomous drone operations, smart traffic management, and real-time environmental monitoring.

title_zh: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版发售 4 天销量突破 520 万份
content_zh:
任天堂 11 月 11 日宣布，Switch 2 版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》发售后 4 天全球销量突破 520 万份，其中日本售出 81 万份。数据包含实体版和下载版，创下任天堂发行的 Switch 2 游戏首发 4 天销量纪录。

这款游戏于 11 月 5 日全球同步发售，是 1998 年 NINTENDO 64 原作的完整重制版。玩家仍会操纵林克往返于少年和成年两个时代，利用各自可用的道具推进冒险。重制版更新了画面，也支持通过 Nintendo Switch App 使用游戏辅助服务 ZELDA NOTES。

🎤 小伙伴们都玩上了吗？
title_en: 'Zelda: Ocarina of Time' Remake Surpasses 5.2 Million Units Sold in First 4 Days
content_en:
Nintendo announced that the Switch 2 version of *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* sold over 5.2 million units globally within four days of its release, including 810,000 copies sold in Japan. The figure, which includes both physical and digital sales, sets a new launch-window record for a Nintendo-published game on the Switch 2 platform.

Released worldwide on November 5, the title is a complete remake of the classic 1998 Nintendo 64 release. It updates the graphics and introduces support for the companion feature "ZELDA NOTES" via the Nintendo Switch App, while preserving the core adventure of Link traveling between youth and adulthood.

title_zh: 四门版长安糯玉米 PLUS 上市，限时权益价 4.99 万元起
content_zh:
11 月 11 日，长安启源旗下的糯玉米 PLUS 上市。新车把原来两个侧门的布局改成四门四座，共推出四款配置，限时权益价为 4.99 万元至 5.69 万元。

糯玉米 PLUS 的车长为 3515 毫米，轴距为 2200 毫米，分别比原版增加 222 毫米和 220 毫米。新车搭载最大功率 35 千瓦的前置单电机，续航有 205 公里和 301 公里两档。

同一价位的微型纯电车正在陆续增加后车门。五菱宏光 MINIEV 已推出四门版，一汽奔腾小马在 10 月底推出五门版。

🔗 相关阅读：4.99 万元起，长安糯玉米 PLUS 变成四门「大玉米」，小车最后还是要「大大大」
title_en: Changan Launches Four-Door Lumin PLUS EV, Priced from 49,900 Yuan
content_en:
Changan Qiyuan officially launched the Lumin PLUS EV on November 11. Upgrading from the original two-door layout, the new model adopts a practical four-door, four-seat configuration. Available in four trim levels, it is currently offered at a limited-time promotional price ranging from 49,900 to 56,900 yuan.

The Lumin PLUS boasts expanded dimensions, measuring 3,515 mm in length with a 2,200 mm wheelbase—an increase of 222 mm and 220 mm over the original version, respectively. Powered by a 35 kW front-mounted single motor, the micro-EV offers two range options: 205 km and 301 km.

Adding rear doors is rapidly becoming a key trend for micro-EVs in this price segment, following recent multi-door updates from rivals like the Wuling Hongguang MINIEV and FAW Bestune Pony.

title_zh: 百度发布文心 5.5 Flash 预览版，已开放 API
content_zh:
百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview，并在百度智能云千帆开放 API。这是此前公开的 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 的首个后训练版本，具备 2800 亿总参数、140 亿激活参数，支持 100 万 Token 上下文。

官方演示中，模型调用工具在 FreeCAD 中制作了可编辑的建筑模型，也展示了生成网页游戏和编制研究报告的过程。百度表示，预览版权重将按 Apache 2.0 许可开放。
title_en: Baidu Unveils ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview with Open API and Apache 2.0 Weights
content_en:
Baidu has launched ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, making its API publicly accessible via the Baidu AI Cloud Qianfan platform. Serving as the first post-trained release of ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, the model features 280 billion total parameters, 14 billion activated parameters, and supports a context window of up to 1 million tokens.

In official demonstrations, the model highlighted strong tool-use capabilities by building editable architectural models in FreeCAD, creating web games, and drafting research reports.

Baidu confirmed that the weights for the preview version will be open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license.

title_zh: 阿里开放 Qwen4-Max 预览版，首发千问 Token Plan
content_zh:
11 月 11 日，阿里开放新一代旗舰模型 Qwen4-Max 的预览版。模型首发上线千问 AI 平台的 Token Plan，千问办公、Qoder、千问 App 和 QwenStudio 也提供抢先体验。

千问团队称，新模型加强了世界知识、感知、编程和智能体能力，面向复杂编程、前端设计、专业办公和专业软件操作等任务。官方展示的内测应用包括 3D 建模、网页设计和交互制作。
title_en: Alibaba Releases Preview of Flagship Qwen4-Max AI Model
content_en:
Alibaba officially opened access to the preview version of its next-generation flagship model, Qwen4-Max, on November 11. The model debuted alongside the new Token Plan on the Qwen AI Platform, with early access available through Qwen Office, Qoder, the Qwen App, and QwenStudio.

According to the Qwen team, the new model features significant upgrades in world knowledge, perception, coding, and AI agent capabilities. It is optimized for complex tasks such as advanced programming, front-end design, professional office workflows, and specialized software operations.

Official demonstrations highlighted early internal applications, including automated 3D modeling, web design, and interactive interface creation.

title_zh: 阿里开源 Qwen Code 1.0 预览版，整合 Qoder 的编程能力
content_zh:
阿里发布了 Qwen Code 1.0 预览版，将 Qoder 和 Qwen Code 的智能体框架能力整合到开源项目中，覆盖代码理解、实现、调试和测试。该版本已在 GitHub 提供下载。

预览版支持 Qwen 和 Qoder 账号、多家模型供应商及自定义兼容接口。macOS、Linux 和 Windows 均有原生安装包，无需单独安装 Node.js。它还能恢复已有会话，便于继续此前的编程任务。
title_en: Alibaba Open-Sources Qwen Code 1.0 Preview with Integrated Qoder Capabilities
content_en:
Alibaba has officially released the open-source preview of Qwen Code 1.0, integrating agent capabilities from both Qoder and Qwen Code. Designed to cover the complete software development lifecycle—including code comprehension, implementation, debugging, and testing—the project is now available for download on GitHub.

The preview version supports accounts from Qwen and Qoder, as well as multiple AI model providers and custom compatible APIs. It offers native installers for macOS, Linux, and Windows without requiring a Node.js setup, and features session recovery so developers can seamlessly resume past coding tasks.

title_zh: 国产纯太阳能无人机「轻骑兵」首飞成功
content_zh:
新华社从中国航天科技集团十一院获悉，国产中小型太阳能无人机「轻骑兵」于 11 月 11 日在西北某机场完成首飞。这款飞行器以太阳能作为唯一动力来源，采用纯电驱动。

机身长 3.2 米，翼展 8 米，最大设计续航为 30 小时。机型采用模块化设计，可适配通信和遥感等民用任务载荷。
title_en: China's Solar-Powered Drone 'Light Cavalry' Completes Maiden Flight
content_en:
China's self-developed small-to-medium solar-powered drone, "Light Cavalry" (Qingqibin), successfully completed its maiden flight at an airfield in northwestern China on November 11, according to the Eleventh Academy of CASC. The aircraft relies entirely on solar energy for pure electric propulsion.

Featuring a 3.2-meter fuselage length and an 8-meter wingspan, the drone boasts a maximum designed endurance of 30 hours. Its modular architecture allows it to carry versatile payloads for civil applications, including telecommunications and remote sensing.

title_zh: DeepL 上线新语音翻译模型，实时保留语气和停顿
content_zh:
DeepL 11 月 11 日推出语音翻译模型 Aure，并将它接入 DeepL Voice。翻译播放时，模型会跟随说话者的语调、情绪、重音和语速变化。例如，发言人在宣布消息前刻意停顿，或在谈判时加重某句话的语气，译出的声音也会反映这些变化。

新模型已自动用于 DeepL Voice 的线上会议、面对面对话和语音 API，无需单独设置。Aure 首批支持英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、日语、葡萄牙语和韩语，其余已支持语种继续由 DeepL Voice 的现有模型处理。
title_en: DeepL Launches 'Aure' Voice Model to Preserve Tone and Nuance in Real-Time Translation
content_en:
DeepL launched its new speech translation model, "Aure," on November 11, integrating it directly into DeepL Voice. The model captures real-time expressive nuances by mirroring the speaker's tone, emotion, stress, and speech rate. For instance, intentional pauses before announcements or emphasized words during negotiations are accurately reflected in the translated audio.

Automated across DeepL Voice for online meetings, face-to-face conversations, and the Voice API, Aure requires no manual setup. The model initially supports English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, and Korean, while existing models continue to handle other supported languages.

title_zh: Google Pixel Tag 开售
content_zh:
Google 宣布，防丢追踪器 Pixel Tag 从 11 月 11 日开始发售，美国单只售价 29.99 美元。它可放进钱包或挂在钥匙上，远距离定位依靠安卓设备组成的 Find Hub 网络。

寻找附近物品时，搭配兼容设备可通过 UWB 查看方向和距离，也可以让追踪器响铃。谷歌称，Pixel Tag 的电池可使用一年以上。
title_en: Google Launches Pixel Tag Tracker Starting at $29.99
content_en:
Google has officially launched its Pixel Tag item tracker, priced at $29.99 in the United States starting November 11. Designed to fit in wallets or attach to keychains, the tracker leverages Android's Find Hub network for long-range location tracking.

For nearby searches, compatible devices can utilize Ultra-Wideband (UWB) technology to display precise direction and distance, or trigger an audible chime on the tag. Google estimates the device's battery life to exceed one year under normal use.

title_zh: 元太把彩色电子纸扩至 9 种基色，Aura 相框率先搭载
content_zh:
元太发布 9 色版 Spectra 6 彩色电子纸，在原有黑、白、红、黄、蓝、绿之外加入橙、青和浅绿。元太称，新增基色可以改善照片的颜色过渡，例如人脸肤色和渐变纹理。

首批面板从 10 英寸规格开始供应，Aura Ink 10 是率先搭载的产品之一。这款无线电子相框的屏幕为 200 PPI，元太称单次充电最长可用三个月。新面板需要搭配系统芯片及元太的时序控制器。
title_en: E Ink Expands Spectra 6 E-Paper to 9 Base Colors, Debuting on Aura Ink 10
content_en:
E Ink has unveiled a 9-color version of its Spectra 6 color e-paper display, introducing orange, cyan, and light green alongside the original six primary colors (black, white, red, yellow, blue, and green). The expanded palette significantly improves color transitions for realistic photo rendering, such as skin tones and smooth gradients.

Initial shipments will begin with 10-inch panels, with the Aura Ink 10 wireless digital photo frame among the first devices to adopt the technology. The frame features a 200 PPI display and offers up to three months of battery life on a single charge. The new displays require integration with dedicated system chips and E Ink's timing controller.

title_zh: IBM 公布量子处理器 Nighthawk r3，计划明年连接两颗芯片
content_zh:
IBM 公布下一代量子处理器 Nighthawk r3。单颗芯片的设计目标是在 520 个可编程量子比特上执行 1 万次量子操作。IBM 计划在 2027 年把两颗 r3 接成一个系统，将可编程量子比特扩至 1040 个。

r3 沿用上一代的方格连接结构，新增 10 条用于连接不同芯片的耦合通道。IBM 今年已用上一代架构的 r1 验证芯片间连接，量子态传输保真度达到 99.3%。目前已可用的 r2 支持在 120 个量子比特上执行超过 7500 次量子操作。
title_en: IBM Reveals Next-Gen Nighthawk r3 Quantum Processor with Multi-Chip Scaling Plans
content_en:
IBM has unveiled its next-generation quantum processor, the Nighthawk r3. Designed to execute up to 10,000 quantum operations across 520 programmable qubits on a single chip, the company plans to link two r3 processors together by 2027, scaling total capability to 1,040 programmable qubits.

The r3 retains its predecessor's grid-style interconnect structure while adding 10 inter-chip coupling channels. IBM previously demonstrated multi-chip connectivity using its r1 architecture, achieving a 99.3% quantum state transfer fidelity. Meanwhile, the currently available r2 processor supports over 7,500 operations across 120 qubits.

title_zh: 星海贝公布《赛博朋克 2077》联名耳机和声卡售价
content_zh:
海贝音乐旗下品牌星海贝公布了与《赛博朋克 2077》联名的两款音频设备售价。Pulse（脉冲）是头戴式耳机，售价 999 元。Grid（矩阵）是外置声卡，售价 1499 元。两款产品计划于 12 月开启预售。

这套联名此前已在《赛博朋克：边缘行者 2》与 Insert Coin 的线下快闪活动亮相，当时展出的是「V」版。
title_en: SingHiFi Reveals Pricing for Official Cyberpunk 2077 Audio Gear
content_en:
SingHiFi, an audio brand under HiBy Music, has officially announced the pricing for its upcoming *Cyberpunk 2077* collaboration. The lineup features the "Pulse" over-ear headphones priced at 999 RMB and the "Grid" external sound card at 1,499 RMB. Both products are scheduled to open for pre-orders this December.

The collaborative hardware was previously previewed at an offline pop-up event hosted by *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners* and Insert Coin, where a custom "V" edition was showcased to fans.

title_zh: 《星际宝贝》新短片公开海报，史迪仔遇到粉色小猫
content_zh:
迪士尼动画公开《星际宝贝》新短片《Lilo & Scratch》的新海报。海报里，一只粉白色小猫蹲在史迪仔身前，片名里的「Stitch」被划掉，旁边写上了小猫的名字「Scratch」。

短片接续 2002 年动画电影。莉萝收养了小猫 Scratch，出门时把它托付给史迪仔。莉萝离开后，这只猫很快就在家里惹出了乱子。动画在水彩背景上结合手绘与电脑动画，克里斯·桑德斯继续为史迪仔配音，真人版莉萝的扮演者玛雅·凯洛哈为动画中的莉萝配音。

《Lilo & Scratch》将随迪士尼动画电影《Hexed》于 11 月 25 日在北美影院贴片放映。
title_en: Disney Teases New 'Lilo & Stitch' Animated Short Short Featuring a Mischievous Kitten
content_en:
Disney Animation has unveiled a new poster for *Lilo & Scratch*, an upcoming animated short continuing the legacy of the 2002 film *Lilo & Stitch*. The poster features a pink-and-white kitten sitting in front of Stitch, with Stitch's name crossed out in the title and replaced by "Scratch."

The storyline picks up as Lilo adopts the kitten and leaves it in Stitch's care, only for chaos to break out shortly after her departure. Combining hand-drawn and computer animation over classic watercolor backgrounds, the short brings back Chris Sanders as the voice of Stitch, while Maia Kealoha, star of the upcoming live-action adaptation, voices Lilo.

*Lilo & Scratch* will premiere in North American theaters on November 25 as a theatrical companion to Disney's animated feature *Hexed*.

title_zh: 华纳开发新版《电子情书》，杰森·奥利执导
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，华纳兄弟正在开发新版《电子情书》，由执导过《超级青春期》的杰森·奥利担任导演。他正在基于黛博拉·卡普兰和哈里·埃尔方特此前撰写的剧本改稿，尼尔·莫里茨和塔尼娅·兰多担任制片。

1998 年原版由诺拉·艾芙隆执导，梅格·瑞恩和汤姆·汉克斯主演。经营独立童书店的女主角在现实里与连锁书店老板竞争，两人却在网上匿名通信，渐渐喜欢上彼此。
title_en: Warner Bros. Developing New 'You've Got Mail' Remake Directed by Jason Orley
content_en:
Warner Bros. is officially developing a new adaptation of the classic romantic comedy *You've Got Mail*, according to *Deadline*. Jason Orley (*Big Time Adolescence*) is set to direct and is currently revising a screenplay originally penned by Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont. Neal Moritz and Tania Landau are producing the film.

The original 1998 hit, directed by Nora Ephron and starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks, told the story of an independent bookstore owner who unwittingly falls in love online with the head of a rival megastore chain competing with her in real life.

title_zh: 《艾米丽在巴黎》最终季首曝预告，艾米丽与加布里埃尔在希腊重逢
content_zh:
Netflix 11 月 11 日放出《艾米丽在巴黎》第六季首支预告。莉莉·柯林斯饰演的艾米丽在希腊与卢卡斯·布哈沃饰演的加布里埃尔重逢，预告也回顾了两人初识等前几季的片段。

第五季结尾，回到巴黎的艾米丽收到加布里埃尔寄来的明信片，邀请她去希腊。最终季会带她前往希腊和摩纳哥，巴黎也将继续出现。第六季将于 12 月 24 日在 Netflix 上线。
title_en: 'Emily in Paris' Teases Final Season Reunion in Greece Ahead of Christmas Premiere
content_en:
Netflix has released the first teaser trailer for the final season of *Emily in Paris*, offering fans a glimpse of Emily (Lily Collins) reuniting with Gabriel (Lucas Bravo) in Greece. The trailer also revisits memorable moments from earlier seasons, tracing the duo's journey from their first meeting.

The storyline picks up following the Season 5 finale, where Emily received a postcard from Gabriel inviting her to Greece. The final chapter will expand its scope to include scenic locations in Greece and Monaco, while continuing to feature its signature Parisian backdrop.

The final season of *Emily in Paris* is scheduled to premiere globally on Netflix on December 24.
